properties.invariant: Every domain-valid request returns a finite normalized value or a registry-approved stable error at a frozen checked intermediate.
Multiplying every positive price by the same positive finite scale preserves simple returns when both paths stay finite.
Multiplying every positive price by the same positive finite scale preserves log differences within the large/property tolerance.
Any valid sequence containing -1 has exact cumulative return -1 even when later terms would otherwise overflow.
For finite valid returns with no -1 and no overflow, the result equals the independently evaluated float64 product of every (1 + return) minus 1 in request order.

Adding a common finite constant preserves sample volatility, while multiplying by a finite factor scales it by the absolute factor; annualized volatility retains the frozen sqrt(periods_per_year) multiplier.
For a valid equity curve the result is finite and lies in [-1,0], and positive common scaling preserves it.
A successful type-7 quantile lies between the finite minimum and maximum observations without replacing the frozen overflow path.

Adding a finite constant shifts VaR and threshold CVaR by that constant; multiplying all observations by a positive finite scale multiplies both results by that scale when every required intermediate stays finite.
The result equals the mean of every actual observation less than or equal to the type-7 VaR threshold, including all ties.
Permuting finite losses preserves fractional historical expected shortfall, and multiplying every loss by a positive finite scale multiplies ES by that scale when the result stays finite.
Permuting intraday log returns preserves realized variance and volatility; volatility squared equals variance within tolerance.
Scaling every intraday return by finite k scales realized variance by k squared and realized volatility by abs(k), subject to frozen finite-result behavior.
The frozen ordered and permuted hand fixtures have distinct expected results; q=1 equals original-frequency population Sharpe exactly within tolerance.
When observed Sharpe equals benchmark Sharpe and the moment radicand is valid, PSR is exactly 0.5 within hand/paper tolerance.
When observed Sharpe equals the frozen expected maximum benchmark Sharpe, DSR is 0.5 and arbitrary-size trial integers preserve their lexical and semantic type.

Valid provenance has raw_trial_count >= effective_trial_count >= 2, effective_trial_count exactly equals trial_count, variance_ddof equals 1, a nonblank sampling frequency, and a lowercase 64-hex registry digest; changing any relation yields trial_provenance_invalid.
Applying the same permutation to realized-loss and forecast-VaR pairs preserves the strict exception sequence count and Kupiec result.
An exception is exactly realized_loss > forecast_var; equality and every lower realized loss are non-exceptions, including negative realized losses.
The frozen ordered and permuted exception sequences have equal exception counts but the exact distinct transition statistics in the canonical expected fixture.
Positive common scaling of each realized-loss and forecast-VaR pair preserves every strict exception and all three test results.
Every successful statistic is nonnegative, every p_value is in [0,1], reject is exactly p_value < significance, and transition counts sum to conditioned observations when present.
The direct LRcc equals conditioned unconditional_component_statistic plus independence_component_statistic within the frozen 128*eps likelihood consistency tolerance.
If either previous-state transition-row total is zero after input and keyword validation, the exact stable result is insufficient_sample.
No successful scalar, vector, or nested record field serializes IEEE-754 negative zero.
